statusMeaning: Families define the full scope. Progress records verified subsets only; presence of an upstream test file is not native acceptance evidence.

progress.managedFoundation: Numeric and timeline shared playback, reactive ownership, spring playback, numeric/grid/automatic/randomized/typed-unit staggering, nested timelines/callbacks, scalar replace property/set tracks, typed CSS declaration/contextual playback, public cached numeric/CSS/component animatables with property-scoped restoration, standalone timers/stretching, easing and value interpolation;1488 unfiltered tests pass normal Release and Traced Debug on the current Windows host.
progress.valueInterpolation: 138 decompositions,137 object and137 CSS schedules/1507 samples each,14 number-format fixtures and guard/validation tests pass. Typed Declaration playback uses existing Timer/ownership, source scalar CSS precision before modifiers, relative operands, templates/padding, legacy gamma-like RGB/linear alpha and inherited per-component guards. Default duration input is uint with explicit precise-float variants. HTML element-context scalar units are integrated; modern colors and SVG-specific contexts remain open. Both public normal/Traced strict NativeAOT PEs exercise the connected adapters. P7 exposes no inspected structured normalized RGBA accessor.
progress.contextualUnits: 16 source conversions/cache collision and six source animation schedules pass;29 added tests cover native DOM protocol, cleanup, primary faults, independent contexts, source operator/normalization order, invalid setup and no per-frame measurements. Actual public CPU JIT/NativeAOT checks prove em16/32, remroot20, containing-block%, source cm integer quantization37.8px and angle225deg with no retained clones. Uses existing HTMLElement/Node/CSSStyleProperties; no new public CSS model. Native adaptation replaces global cross-context cache with per-construction measurements and rejects angle/length mixing. Scoped review no findings; SVG contexts, modern colors and refresh remain open.
progress.playbackTiming: Geometry55 cases/929 samples, standalone state51 traces, scheduled timers34 traces, numeric52 traces and timeline60 source traces pass, including mutable timer/numeric stretching. The reviewed playback checkpoint passed631/631; current full suites pass1488/1488. Its two Important review issues were fixed with source-resume traces and reentry regressions. Current normal/Traced strict NativeAOT PEs pass against public Core/DOM56/CSS2/View45/NativeP7 CPU. Full Timeline controls, global engine arbitration and the complete capability inventory remain open.
progress.timelinePlayback: All60 captured source timeline traces now run native comparisons, including root/property/call output, owned timer callbacks/self-state and borrowed timer/animation/nested callback/state snapshots. Fifty-two root-clock comparisons independently replay source child aggregates; six phase tests and16 lifetime/authoring tests plus five review regressions pass. Cases include FPS, speed before rounding/skipping, signed delay/gaps, zero/forever/uint/fractional durations and reverse-loop completion. Resumed borrowed controller traces verify pause/seek/resume callbacks and guarded reentry. Full plain property-track lifecycle callbacks remain open.
progress.easing: 46 default named easings plus441 original samples remain covered. Additional37 typed linear,36 deterministic irregular,72 parameterized directional family,7 Bezier and6 step cases match pinned source at18 progress points each, including signed extrapolation and IEEE singularities. Array capture, validation, constructor-only random effects, shared-random stability and runner integration are tested. Typed positions replace percentage strings; finite authoring and uint counts are deliberate native contracts. Current normal/Traced public CPU JIT and strict NativeAOT PEs exercise piecewise overshoot/layout/completion and retained irregular draws. This does not establish global engine/property/composition parity.
progress.animatables: Public Animatable groups, NumericProperty-backed numeric handles and existing-Declaration CSS handles support cached getters, scalar/partial-component retargeting, retained duration/ease, uint/precise timing, shared ordered frames, independent callback clocks and Ranvier ownership. Twenty-five numeric and nine CSS-interface source schedules pass, including full numeric/compound revert;36 isolated source fixtures are pinned. Inline value/priority/absence snapshots preserve unrelated edits; actual computed capture and per-element scalar-unit conversion pass native tests. Array getters are independent snapshots, target groups require nonempty arrays and terminal mutations throw instead of source noops. Important destinations commit atomically with endpoints. Review's callback-fault and typed-property-cancellation findings are fixed. Global composition interactions, broader object adapters and modern CSS/SVG contexts remain open.
progress.springs: Physical/perceived spring modes, parameter clamps/mutations, perceived completion and settling-duration playback compare against twelve constructor and six mutation snapshots. Whole-millisecond perceived input accepts uint; precise fractional input remains supported.
progress.staggering: 67 numeric/geometry/random fixtures,7 unit fixtures and7 timeline-position fixtures cover step/range, origins, explicit and automatic 2D/3D geometry, axes, reversal, easing, start, modifiers, total overrides, index mapping, random origins, seeded jitter and checked typed CSS output. Existing DOMPointInit and Element APIs support measured positions; recording-interface tests verify centers and measurement counts. Actual native layout/unit integration and string-label stagger starts remain incomplete.
progress.timelines: Existing29 position,3 synchronized-child,7 stagger,6 callback,2 nested and56 scalar schedule fixtures remain green;60 shared-playback comparisons now cover owned timers and borrowed timer/animation/nested controllers. Scalar replace/set composition, repeat/direction/speed, root/owned/borrowed callbacks, ancestor guards and ownership are covered subsets. Full property-track callbacks, additive/blend/global composition, keyframes, removal, stretch/refresh/revert and promises remain incomplete.
progress.nativeIntegration: Normal Release and Traced Debug JIT and strict NativeAOT PEs pass against public Core/DOM56/CSS2/View45/NativeP7 CPU packages. Nine managed identities match pinned nupkg/cache/app/ILC bytes and provenance;24 native CPU members match the independently audited ABI62/slim/win-x64 payload. Schema4 public-css-animatable archives retain nine files per mode and current library/consumer hashes; live Debug binds346 authored/190 ILC inputs. Public numeric/CSS/component handles, computed style capture, per-element retarget units, scoped inline restoration and owner disposal pass alongside earlier playback/layout/interpolation checks, host.Errors=0. Both receipts/all18 files and current sources verify. Hardware acceleration, successor cohorts, Linux, worker-thread exit, host destruction and full parity remain unqualified.
